# Testprune local reference

Read SKILL.md for the current locally adapted workflow. This copy preserves
read-only audits, scoped cleanup, supported behavior, safe offline checks,
repository-specific runners, and the existing default command's meaning.

- SKILL.md: scope and workflow.
- references/prompt_creator.md: read-only handoff drafting.
- references/followups_execution.md: resolving conflicting intent.
- references/techniques.md: runner-aware inspection and changes.
- references/gate_script_template.sh: optional pytest example, not universal.
- scripts/test_inventory.py: heuristic disk/Git candidates, not runner collection.

Upstream: https://github.com/NeuraCerebra-AI/testprune
